library.name: Google API Client Library for PHP
library.description: Client library for Google APIs. Used by the plugin to talk to Classroom, Drive, Calendar and Forms.

library.name: Google API Client Services
library.description: Generated service definitions for the Google APIs, pruned at install time to the services the plugin uses (Classroom, Drive, Calendar, Forms and Oauth2).

library.name: Google Auth Library for PHP
library.description: OAuth 2.0 credentials and token handling for the Google API client.

library.name: Monolog
library.description: Logging library. Required by the Google API client; the plugin does not log through it.

library.name: PSR-6 Caching Interface
library.description: Common interface for caching libraries. Required by the Google Auth library.

library.name: Composer autoloader
library.description: Autoloader generated by Composer for the libraries above. Patched so that it does not claim the legacy global Google_* class names, which belong to the google-api-php-client v1 that Moodle core still ships; see composer.json -> extra.tresipunt-notes.vendor-patch.
